Rankscale is a tool for generative engine optimization (GEO). It shows how your brand, website, product or service appears in the answers of AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and DeepSeek, and what you can do to improve it.
AI search engines answer a question directly and name the brands they trust. Rankscale measures whether your brand is one of them, over time and across engines.

You can audit your website to see how AI understands it, find gaps and content optimization potential, and track your presence in AI search results. Rankscale also analyzes the sources an answer cites and the sentiment around your brand, and shows how competitors perform on the same questions.

Marketing, SEO and content teams use Rankscale to see where they show up in AI answers and what to fix first. Agencies use it to report AI visibility for their clients. Larger organizations have a dedicated enterprise offering.
